import TokenBucket.Spec
namespace TokenBucket
instance instDecidableAdmissible (s : State) (r : Request) : Decidable (Admissible s r) := by
  unfold Admissible; infer_instance
def step : Impl := fun s r =>
  if Admissible s r then
    (.ok, { s with tokens := refilled s r.time - r.cost, last := r.time })
  else (.rejected, s)
theorem req_valid_succeeds       : ValidSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop         : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_allow_iff_sufficient : AllowIffSufficient step := sorry
theorem req_time_monotone        : TimeMonotone step := sorry
theorem req_remaining            : Remaining step := sorry
theorem req_effects              : Effects step := sorry
theorem req_capacity             : CapacityBound step := sorry
end TokenBucket

text: Fixing the double-refill and proving timed acceptance next.

args.code:
theorem req_allow_iff_sufficient : AllowIffSufficient step := by
  intro s r hle hpos
  unfold step
  simp only
  by_cases h : Admissible s r
  · simp [h]
    exact (Admissible s r).mp h |>.2.2
    -- Actually need cost ≤ refilled: from h
  · simp [h]
    unfold Admissible at h
    push_neg at h
    have h' : ¬ (r.cost ≤ refilled s r.time) := by
      intro hle2
      exact h hle ⟨hpos, hle2⟩
    exact h'

theorem req_remaining : Remaining step := by
  intro s r hok
  have h : Admissible s r := by
    by_contra hn
    have heq : (step s r).1 = .rejected := by simp [step, hn]
    rw [heq] at hok
    contradiction
  have e1 : (step s r).1 = .ok := hok
  have e2 : (step s r).2.tokens + r.cost = refilled s r.time := by
    simp [step, h]
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel h.2.2
  exact e2
